spans.s: उभ pron. (used in the dual only.) Both, उभौ यदि व्योम्नि पृथक्प्रवाहावाकाशगंगापयसः Sis.iii.8, K.S.iv.43, M.ii.14.

उभय pron. (f. यी) (Though this word has a dualistic sense, it is used in the singular and plural only; some authorities, however, use it in the dual also.) Both, उभयमानशिरे वसुधाधिपाः R.ix.9; उभयीं सिद्धिमुभाववापतुः viii.23, Am.

उभय pron. (f. यी) (Though this word has a dualistic sense, it is used in the singular and plural only; some authorities, however, use it in the dual also.) Both, उभयमानशिरे वसुधाधिपाः R.ix.9; उभयीं सिद्धिमुभाववापतुः viii.23, Am.
उभय-चर a. living in water and on land, amphibious.
उभय-तस् ind. 1. from both sides, on both sides, (with the acc.), e.g. उभयतः कृष्णं गोपाः S.K., M.viii.315, Yaj.i.18; 2. in both cases; 3. in both ways, M.i.47.
उभय-तस्˚दत्, ˚दंत a. having a double row of teeth, M.i.43.
उभय-तस्˚दत्, ˚दंत a. having a double row of teeth, M.i.43.
उभय-तस्˚मुख a. 1. looking either way; 2. two-faced.
उभय-तस्˚मुखी f. a cow, Yaj.i.206.
उभय-त्र ind. 1. in both places; 2. on both sides; 3. in both cases, M.iii.125.
उभय-त्र˚चर a. living in water and on land, amphibious.
उभय-था ind. 1. in both ways; 2. in both cases.
उभय-विद्या f. the two fold science, i.e. religious knowledge and knowledge about worldly affairs.
उभय-व्यंजन a. having the marks of both sexes.
उभय-संभव m. dilemma.
उभये(य)द्युस् ind. 1. On both days; 2. on two subsequent days.
उभये(य)द्युस् ind. 1. On both days; 2. on two subsequent days.
